name: peg-bloom

plan.instruction: Repair app.mjs while retaining all controls. Two defects: handleClick returns early for EMPTY cells, so jumping is impossible. First check whether selected plus clicked destination matches a legal move; apply it if so; only otherwise select an occupied cell or clear selection. Second: hint() incorrectly applies every solution move to CURRENT pegs. Instead replay from a COPY OF currentPuzzle.start, comparing sorted sets with current pegs BEFORE each replay step. If they match, select solution[i][0], updateUI and return. Otherwise advance the replay state using applyMove. If no match, show restart suggestion. Never execute an illegal replay move on current board. Keep undo, restart, puzzle selection and counter working.
